description: A JSON OpenAPI specification for 'Interfaces.IP' API endpoints related to IP interface management, including methods for adding, listing, retrieving, deleting, resetting statistics, and updating IP interfaces.

methods.name: Interfaces.IP.List
methods.description: Retrieves a list of IP Interfaces.

methods.name: Interfaces.IP.{InterfaceId}.Get
methods.description: Retrieves the status and configuration parameters of the specified IP Interface.

methods.name: Interfaces.IP.{InterfaceId}.ResetStatistics
methods.description: Resets the statistics counters of the specified IP Interface.

methods.name: Interfaces.IP.{InterfaceId}.Set
methods.description: Modifies the status and configuration parameters of the specified IP Interface.
